editorial:
Imagine being so sick of your spouse that you have already signed the divorce papers, only to get into a wild accident and forget who they are. That is exactly what happens here. You get to follow a couple who hated each other's guts, but suddenly, they are strangers who find each other incredibly attractive and sweet. It is a total chaos-fest with a lot of heart, making you wonder if love is something you choose or something that just happens to you regardless of your past mistakes.

The acting is the best part because the leads nail the shift from angry fighting to cute flirting. The pacing stays quick, though some of the jokes are a bit silly, which actually adds to the charm. If you are looking for a lighthearted date night movie, you should definitely check this out. It is a great pick if you need a laugh and a few happy tears.
endingExplained: After getting their memories back, the couple realizes that while they had real problems, they still truly love each other. They decide that the amnesia was a wake-up call to stop fighting and start communicating. Instead of going through with the divorce, they tear up the settlement papers. The movie ends with them choosing to start their marriage over from scratch, this time with more patience and kindness toward one another.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves rom-coms with a twist and happy endings.
